name: 19958 · Lewes, DE
findings: ZIP 19958 (Lewes) has 163 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19958 (Lewes) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19958 (Lewes) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
